rows.commentary: 0.1: Kranti Gaud begins the attack, offering a delivery outside off that Kelis Ndhlovu steers down to deep backward point for a single.
0.2: Kranti Gaud maintains the same probing channel outside off, and Beloved Biza defends solidly into the point region for no score.
0.3: Kranti Gaud spears this full delivery down leg, missing the bat of Beloved Biza as it deflects off the pad and scampers away to fine leg for a leg bye.
0.4: Kranti Gaud delivers to Kelis Ndhlovu as frantic pursuit and errant relay yield five chaotic runs.
0.5: No run for Beloved Biza off Kranti Gaud.
0.6: Kranti Gaud traps Beloved Biza dead in front, and Anna Harris swiftly points the finger to end a four-ball duck.
1.1: Nandani Sharma drops it short outside the channel, and Kelis Ndhlovu cracks a fierce cut directly to sweeper cover.
1.2: Nandani Sharma lands it full and swinging away, drawing a thick edge from Mupachikwa that falls safely short of Charani at short third.
1.3: Nandani Sharma drops it on a good length outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa steps back to punch a single toward deep point.
1.4: Nandani Sharma angles one into the pads down the leg side, beating Kelis Ndhlovu's flick as the umpire easily dismisses the muted appeal.
1.5: Nandani Sharma targets the legs once more, allowing Kelis Ndhlovu to turn the delivery away smoothly into the deep square leg region for a single.

1.6: Nandani Sharma drops it full and angled across the right-hander, inviting the drive from Modester Mupachikwa who leans in and connects cleanly, only to pick out the fielder stationed sharply at extra-cover.
2.1: Kranti Gaud lands a full delivery outside off, and Kelis Ndhlovu strides forward to push it toward Prasad patrolling extra cover.
2.2: Kranti Gaud targets a good length outside the off stump, tempting Kelis Ndhlovu into a slash that beats the bat entirely.
2.3: Kranti Gaud lofts it up full on off, and Kelis Ndhlovu clears the front leg to bludgeon a convincing drive screaming past mid-off for four.

2.4: Kranti Gaud digs this delivery in short and well wide of off stump, drawing Kelis Ndhlovu into an expansive pull shot that sails harmlessly past the bat straight to Richa Ghosh, and the umpire stretches the arms to signal an extra.
2.4: Four to Kelis Ndhlovu off Kranti Gaud.
2.5: Kranti Gaud lands it on a good length around middle, inviting Kelis Ndhlovu back to nudge it cleanly past mid-wicket for a single.
2.6: Kranti Gaud lands it on a good length around middle, keeping low to beat Modester Mupachikwa, who retreats to the back foot and nudges it toward mid-wicket.
3.1: Shafali Verma probes the channel outside off, and Kelis Ndhlovu rocks back to smash a flat cut straight to backward point.
3.2: Shafali Verma repeats the length outside off, inviting another fierce cut that finds Anushka stationed precisely at point.
3.3: Shafali Verma delivers a full‑length ball to Kelis Ndhlovu, who drives it wide of mid‑off for four, beating Harman with ease.
3.4: Shafali Verma bowls a flat, good‑length ball outside off to Kelis Ndhlovu, who punches it wide of extra‑cover for a single.
3.5: Dot ball from Shafali Verma to Mupachikwa.
3.6: Shafali Verma delivers a slow, full toss just outside off to Modester Mupachikwa, who deftly uses her feet to nudge it back toward the bowler.
4.1: Nandani Sharma drops it on a good length outside off, keeping unusually low as Kelis Ndhlovu rocks back to carve it wide of extra-cover for a single.
4.2: Nandani Sharma delivers it on a length outside off at 87.5kph, offering just enough time for Mupachikwa to slide back and punch through cover-point to collect one.
4.3: Nandani Sharma delivers a full length outside the off stump, which Kelis Ndhlovu punches straight to the fielder stationed at extra cover.
4.4: Nandani Sharma rolls her fingers over the seam for a clever back-of-the-hand delivery, and Kelis Ndhlovu leans into the line, nudging it toward cover-point.
4.5: Nandani Sharma spears in a searing inswinger at one hundred and three kilometers per hour, forcing Kelis Ndhlovu to hurriedly dig it out straight back at the bowler.
4.6: No run for Kelis Ndhlovu off Nandani Sharma.
5.1: Deepti Sharma drops the pace on a length around middle and leg, drawing Modester Mupachikwa back to nudge it firmly into the square-leg region for a single.
5.2: Deepti Sharma loops it up, the fielder fails to cleanly collect as it slips through, and India pays the price with an overthrow running all the way to the boundary rope for four extra runs.
5.3: Dot ball from Deepti Sharma to Kelis Ndhlovu.
5.4: Deepti Sharma loops this one on leg and middle, allowing Kelis Ndhlovu to sweep it away firmly through square leg for a single.
5.5: Deepti Sharma offers a full delivery outside off, prompting Mupachikwa to skip down the pitch and loft it toward deep midwicket for a comfortable run.
5.6: Deepti Sharma slows the pace on a good length, and Kelis Ndhlovu steps forward to dead-bat it toward cover-point.
6.1: Arundhati Reddy delivers a full ball just outside off to Modester Mupachikwa, who drives it to mid‑off for no run.
6.2: Arundhati Reddy bowls a good length outside off to Modester Mupachikwa, who mistimes a cut toward point for no run.
6.3: Mupachikwa does not score off Arundhati Reddy.
6.4: Arundhati Reddy drops it on a good length at leg-stump, and Modester Mupachikwa steps back to work it into the deep square-leg region for a single.
6.5: Arundhati Reddy drops it short on the stumps, and Kelis Ndhlovu climbs onto the back foot to pull it away to the deep square-leg fence for four.
6.6: Arundhati Reddy delivers again, and Kelis Ndhlovu dispatches it to the boundary with an authoritative cut for four more.
7.1: Deepti Sharma delivers a clever off-cutter outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa steps back to pierce the off-side only to find backward point waiting.
7.2: Deepti Sharma offers flight, prompting Modester Mupachikwa to charge down the pitch and loft it down to long-on for a single.
7.3: Deepti Sharma goes round the wicket with a full delivery, and Kelis Ndhlovu unleashes a fierce slog-sweep that is swiftly intercepted by the deep mid-wicket fielder.
7.4: Deepti Sharma lands a turning off-break on a good length, allowing Modester Mupachikwa to drop back and nudge it neatly into the square-leg region.
7.6: Deepti Sharma loops this one through at seventy-two point six kilometers per hour, outfoxing Kelis Ndhlovu on the back foot as the batter chops the ball straight back down the pitch.
8.1: Shree Charani floats one up on a good length outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa presses forward to punch it past the scrambling cover fielder for an effortless couple.
8.2: Shree Charani maintains her probing channel just outside off, drawing Modester Mupachikwa onto the front foot to bunt the ball safely toward cover-point.
8.3: Shree Charani darts a short and wide delivery outside off, leaving Modester Mupachikwa kicking herself on the back foot after entirely missing her intended cut.
8.4: Shree Charani floats it full on middle, and Modester Mupachikwa strides forward to block it straight back down the pitch.
8.5: Shree Charani tosses one up outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa dances down the track to loft it over mid-off for a brisk couple.

8.6: Shree Charani offers a flat good-length delivery outside off, and Modester Mupachikwa decisively rocks back to punch it hard past cover, beating Kranti's frantic chase from deep extra-cover to race away for four.
9.1: Shafali Verma spears a flat delivery into the channel outside off, and Kelis Ndhlovu rocks back to carve it hard through the cover region for a single.
9.2: Mupachikwa does not score off Shafali Verma.
9.3: Shafali Verma slides it flat on a good length, worked off the back foot by Modester Mupachikwa into the deep backward square-leg region for a comfortable run.
9.4: Shafali Verma strays in line, promptly punished by Kelis Ndhlovu who races it away to the boundary.
9.5: Shafali Verma bowls to Kelis Ndhlovu, a clean delivery that slips past the bat with no run, while the second commentator notes a missed cut.
9.6: Shafali Verma delivers to Kelis Ndhlovu, a fuller ball landing over the wicket and outside off, steering into the short third without scoring.
10.1: Shree Charani bowls a flat good‑length ball to Modester Mupachikwa, who steps onto the back foot and returns it cleanly for no run.
10.2: Shree Charani delivers a crisp ball to Mupachikwa, who is snared as a caught‑and‑bowled dismissal, leaving him stranded on 16 off 26 with one boundary.
10.3: A single to Mayers off Shree Charani.
10.4: Shree Charani delivers a good‑length ball outside off, Kelis Ndhlovu misses the cut, and the ball exits the stumps to the left‑hander.
10.5: Dot ball from Shree Charani to Kelis Ndhlovu.

10.6: Shree Charani bowls a full ball on middle and leg to Kelis Ndhlovu; she misses the flick, India appeal for lbw, the decision is turned down, and Mandhana opts to review after a long chat with Charani and Richa.
11.1: Mayers does not score off Deepti Sharma.
11.2: Mayers does not score off Deepti Sharma.
11.3: Deepti Sharma delivers a good length off‑break that turns into the middle; Mayers steps back and slices a cut to mid‑off, the ball thudding into the left.
11.4: Deepti Sharma bowls a good length ball that nudges just outside off; Mayers, with a grin, misfires a cut that dribbles back to the bowler's left.
11.5: Deepti Sharma unleashes a full‑length off‑break that sails over mid‑off for a four as the fielder struggles to stop it.
11.6: A single to Mayers off Deepti Sharma.
12.1: Mayers takes a single off Shree Charani.
12.2: Dot ball from Shree Charani to Kelis Ndhlovu.
12.3: No run for Kelis Ndhlovu off Shree Charani.
12.4: Dot ball from Shree Charani to Kelis Ndhlovu.
12.5: Shree Charani locks onto the stumps with a good-length delivery, prompting Kelis Ndhlovu forward to bat it solidly back down the pitch.
12.6: No run for Kelis Ndhlovu off Shree Charani.
13.1: Mayers does not score off Shafali Verma.
13.2: Shafali Verma bowls a quick good‑length delivery to Mayers that turns to the right of Harman, but Mayers is sent back and no run is taken.
13.3: Shafali Verma delivers a full ball on off to Mayers, who drives it straight to the fielder at mid‑off for no run.
13.4: Mayers takes 2 off Shafali Verma.
13.5: Six to Mayers off Shafali Verma.
13.6: Mayers takes a single off Shafali Verma.
14.1: Arundhati Reddy bowls a full, wide outside off to Sharne Mayers, who unleashes a thunderous FOUR, sending the ball well wide of mid‑off.
14.2: Mayers takes a single off Arundhati Reddy.
14.3: Arundhati Reddy bowls a slower ball, a leg‑cutter full outside off, Kelis Ndhlovu swings forward to loft but misses.
14.4: No run for Kelis Ndhlovu off Arundhati Reddy.
14.5: Arundhati Reddy drops the slower ball full outside off, tempting Kelis Ndhlovu into a lofted drive that she miscues horribly into the turf.
14.6: Arundhati Reddy bowls a wide to Kelis Ndhlovu.
14.6: Arundhati Reddy crashes through the defense, uprooting Kelis Ndhlovu for a determined 42 after forty-four balls adorned with six boundaries.
Arundhati Reddy strikes again in the over, claiming her second wicket as ZIMW moves to 82/3!
15.1: Mayers takes a single off Nandani Sharma.
15.2: Nyasha Gwanzura takes a single off Nandani Sharma.
15.3: Nandani Sharma drops in a deceptive back-of-the-hand slower delivery, full and wide outside off, which Sharne Mayers pushes forward to meet but fails to time, steering it straight to mid-off.
15.4: Nandani Sharma drops another clever back-of-the-hand slower delivery on a good length outside off, completely deceiving Sharne Mayers who swings hard and air-kicks in frustration.
15.5: Nandani Sharma hurls it in at Mayers, an almighty shout for leg-before echoes around the square, but the umpire remains entirely unmoved as it sails past without scoring.
15.6: Nandani Sharma bowls a length back‑hand slower ball outside off, and Sharne Mayers steps forward, swiping it to mid‑on for a single.
16.1: Shree Charani floats one up on off stump, drawing Mayers forward into a dead-bat defensive push straight down the pitch.
16.2: Shree Charani drifts one in following Sharne Mayers down leg, and the batter muscles a heavy pull into the deep before Niki mops it up to restrict them to two.
16.3: Shree Charani attacks middle stump on a good length, giving Sharne Mayers no width to work with as she rocks back and defends solidly toward extra-cover.
16.4: Shree Charani delivers a crisp stump‑to‑stump line that skids to the middle‑stump; Mayers flicks it, a thick inside‑edge ricocheting onto her leg, sparing her a plumb LBW.
16.5: Shree Charani bowls a sharp, no‑flight, good‑length ball on leg‑stump; Mayers backs away, smashes it to long‑on for a single.
16.6: Shree Charani lofts a full‑outside‑off toss; Nyasha Gwanzura drives it left of extra‑cover, Mandhana half‑stops the ball as she dives, and they settle for a single.

17.1: Arundhati Reddy delivers a sharp good‑length ball outside off; Nyasha Gwanzura swings back‑foot, attempts a cut, but the shot misfires into the vacant cover‑point, leaving the ball stranded inside the inner circle.
17.2: Arundhati Reddy floats up a slower leg-cutter, and Sharne Mayers reaches out, unleashing pure force to launch it soaring over wide long-off for six.
17.3: Arundhati Reddy drops it on a tighter good length outside off, and Sharne Mayers can only guide it straight to the fielder at point.
17.4: Arundhati Reddy delivers a length ball angling in, catching Sharne Mayers on the body as she misses her intended leg-side heave.
17.5: Arundhati Reddy drops it on a length outside off, and Mayers clears room to hammer it through the off side for a boundary that pushes the team total to the hundred mark.
17.6: Arundhati Reddy serves it on a length outside off, and Sharne Mayers punishes the width with a blistering cut through the gap behind point.
18.1: Deepti Sharma loops a full delivery into middle, met solidly by the forward defense of Nyasha Gwanzura.
18.2: Deepti Sharma pushes another full ball outside off, stabbed firmly toward extra-cover by Nyasha Gwanzura for a successive dot.
18.3: Deepti Sharma drifts one on a good length outside off, allowing Nyasha Gwanzura to drop back and carve it past the infield for four.
18.4: Deepti Sharma darts a quicker good-length delivery outside off, blocked firmly into the covers by the back-foot stroke of Nyasha Gwanzura.
18.5: A single to Nyasha Gwanzura off Deepti Sharma.
18.6: Deepti Sharma delivers a full length ball outside leg, and Mayers backs away sharply to clip it off her toes toward deep midwicket for a frantic two runs to wrap up Deepti's spell.
19.1: Nandani Sharma delivers on a good length outside off, and Nyasha Gwanzura punches it firmly toward cover for no run.
19.2: Nandani Sharma delivers full outside off, Nyasha Gwanzura edges closer to the line and thumps it toward cover's right for a brisk single.
19.3: Nandani Sharma rolls her fingers over a full leg-stump delivery, and Sharne Mayers steps forward to wrist it away to deep square-leg on the bounce.
19.4: Nandani Sharma outfoxes Nyasha Gwanzura with a sharp delivery, leaving Richa Ghosh ample time to whip off the bails and complete a smart stumping.
19.5: Nandani Sharma delivers the final blow as Michelle Mavunga advances, misses completely, and Richa Ghosh whips off the bails in a flash to seal a duck.

19.6: Nandani Sharma steams in from around the wicket, hurling a length ball on middle that Mugeri decisively works away toward backward square leg for a single, bringing the Zimbabwe innings to a close at 114 for 5.
Ball 0: With Smriti Mandhana at the wicket and Shafali Verma ready to bat, the onslaught is set to begin as Tendai Makusha steps up to open the attack.
Nandani Sharma claims her second wicket of the over, tightening the squeeze as ZIMW reaches 113 for 5!
0.1: Tendai Makusha pins a sharp back-of-a-length delivery right on the corridor outside off, and Smriti Mandhana steps solidly behind the line to block it back down the pitch.
0.2: Tendai Makusha serves up a much fuller length on off stump, allowing Smriti Mandhana to stroke a firm drive straight to mid-off.
0.3: Tendai Makusha misjudges his radar entirely, sending a full delivery angling sharply down the leg side to signal a wide.
0.3: Tendai Makusha drops fractionally short, and Smriti Mandhana reacts in a heartbeat, pulling the delivery over the infield and away to the deep mid-wicket boundary for four.
0.4: Four to Smriti Mandhana off Tendai Makusha.
0.5: Tendai Makusha pitches it full, and Smriti Mandhana fires a crisp square drive out to deep point for a single.
0.6: Shafali Verma finds the boundary off Tendai Makusha for four.
1.1: Nyasha Gwanzura strikes early as Smriti Mandhana misjudges the pull and picks out Tendai Makusha in the deep.
1.2: Gwanzura slides a flat trajectory past the channel, inviting Anushka Sharma to stroke a defensive bat toward the off-side.
1.3: Width arrives on a tossed-up length, and Anushka swiftly pivots backward to dispatch a crisp cut through backward point for four.
1.4: Reaching for a fuller delivery outside off, Anushka slices an attempted drive straight to Kelis Ndhlovu at backward point, gifting Gwanzura a second wicket.
1.5: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses it wide outside off, and Harmanpreet Kaur reaches out for an expansive drive only to find empty air.
1.6: Nyasha Gwanzura drifts it shorter outside off, Kaur works it off the back foot toward point where a misfield allows the single.
2.1: Dot ball from Michelle Mavunga to Harmanpreet Kaur.
2.2: Michelle Mavunga traps Harmanpreet Kaur as the Indian captain departs cheaply, caught smartly by Nyasha Gwanzura.
2.3: Michelle Mavunga bowls a full outside off to Niki Prasad, who misses it as it drifts away, the ball carrying low to the keeper.
2.4: Michelle Mavunga delivers a length ball outside off to Niki Prasad, who defends it toward backward point.
2.5: Michelle Mavunga bowls to Niki Prasad, but the batsman fails to score.
2.6: Michelle Mavunga delivers a length ball on the off, Niki Prasad defends to the off‑side, no runs, and the over concludes.
ZIMW have swung the match their way.
3.1: Gwanzura strikes again in Raipur, enticing Shafali Verma into a lofted drive that balloons straight back for a sharp, diving catch to the bowler's right.
3.2: Nyasha Gwanzura arrows a full delivery onto the pads, tucked neatly by Deepti Sharma toward square leg.
3.3: Nyasha Gwanzura tosses this one up on the off stump, met with a forward defensive prod from Deepti Sharma.
3.4: Nyasha Gwanzura drops it full, pushed firmly by Deepti Sharma down the ground for a single to long-on.
3.5: Nyasha Gwanzura floats it up, and Niki Prasad drifts back to work it down to long-on, marking her very first runs on the international stage.
3.6: Nyasha Gwanzura floats this slightly shorter delivery in, allowing Deepti Sharma to punch it firmly to long-on for a single.
4.1: Michelle Mavunga drops it short into the surface, and Deepti Sharma crouching low swats the pull shot away to the boundary at deep square leg.
4.2: Michelle Mavunga delivers on a length angling across, and Deepti Sharma pushes firmly to the covers.
4.3: Michelle Mavunga tests the tighter line around off-stump, met by Deepti Sharma off the back foot into the covers.
4.4: Michelle Mavunga offers room outside off, allowing Sharma to tap into the gap and scamper through for a brisk single.
4.5: Michelle Mavunga bowls a short ball outside off to Niki Prasad, who steers it straight to the fielder at point for no run.
4.6: Michelle Mavunga delivers a length ball on leg to Niki Prasad, who nudges it towards wide mid-on for no run.
5.1: Nyasha Gwanzura delivers a full, drifting ball from round the wicket to Deepti Sharma, who stays back and defends it.
5.2: Nyasha Gwanzura sends a straight, arrow‑like ball to Deepti Sharma, who strides down the track, kneels, and smashes it over the non‑striker for four.
5.3: Nyasha Gwanzura bowls a short ball to Deepti Sharma, who pulls it deftly to backward square‑leg for a single.
5.4: Nyasha Gwanzura delivers a single to Niki Prasad, who sweeps it high over long‑on, the ball landing safely in the air.
5.5: No run for Deepti Sharma off Nyasha Gwanzura.
5.6: Nyasha Gwanzura bowls a well‑tossed delivery that Deepti Sharma answers with a lofted four over mid‑on, ending the power‑play.
INDW have swung the match their way, trailing 77 runs to target 115.
6.1: Francisca Chipare drops it on off, and Niki Prasad clears her front leg to heave it through midwicket for four.
6.2: Francisca Chipare floats a full delivery outside off and Niki Prasad expertly steers it toward point.
6.3: Francisca Chipare offers a length ball that Niki Prasad charges down to meet, threading a perfectly timed drive wide of the fielder for four.
6.4: Niki Prasad does not score off Francisca Chipare.
6.5: Francisca Chipare angles it in on a probing length, allowing Niki Prasad to ease it down to long-on for an easy single.
6.6: Francisca Chipare delivers a full ball to Deepti Sharma, who drives it outside off through cover‑point for a single, the tenth run of the over.
7.1: Olinder Chare bowls a shortish delivery to Deepti Sharma, who smashes it down the ground to long‑on for one run.
7.2: Olinder Chare delivers a fuller ball to Niki Prasad, who clips it in front of square‑leg for a single.
7.3: Olinder Chare delivers to Deepti Sharma, a ball that stops on her, yielding no runs.
7.4: Olinder Chare finds Deepti Sharma for a single.
7.5: Olinder Chare delivers a low full‑toss to Niki Prasad, who drives it past the fielder to wide long‑off.
7.6: Olinder Chare bowls a length ball to Deepti Sharma, who punches it through wide mid‑on.
8.1: Beloved Biza loops it up outside off, inviting the stroke as Deepti Sharma presses forward to punch it cleanly toward sweeper cover for a single.
8.2: Beloved Biza attacks the stumps, forcing Niki Prasad onto the back foot to block.
8.3: Beloved Biza drops it short outside off, allowing Niki Prasad to rock back and hammer it away for four.
8.4: Beloved Biza delivers a full ball on off stump, defended squarely back toward mid-on by Niki Prasad for no run.
8.5: Beloved Biza floats it outside off, Niki Prasad swings hard for the slog and top-edges it safely over the wicketkeeper's head to collect a single.
8.6: Beloved Biza drifts it up full on middle and leg, and Deepti Sharma simply strokes it down to long-on for a comfortable single.
INDW swing the match their way, reaching 57 for 4 in 8.3 overs and needing 57 more runs to win!
9.1: Olinder Chare loops it up near the off stump, prompting Deepti Sharma to advance down the track and drill it down to long-on for a single.
9.2: Olinder Chare strays onto the pads, allowing Niki Prasad to deflect it past the fielder and race away to the fine leg boundary.
9.3: Olinder Chare pitches it full on off stump, and Niki Prasad advances down the track to punch it out towards sweeper cover.
9.4: Olinder Chare serves up a juicy full toss outside off, and Deepti Sharma drops to one knee to sweep it hard in front of square on the leg side.
9.5: Olinder Chare strays on length once too often, and Deepti Sharma pounces, standing tall to whip the ball violently away from mid-off for four.
9.6: Olinder Chare delivers a length ball on off, Deepti Sharma punches it to long‑on for one run.
INDW reach 69 for 4 after 9.4 overs, needing 45 more to win against ZIMW and now looking all but certain of victory!
10.1: Beloved Biza loops it full into the stumps, and Deepti Sharma pushes the delivery straight to the waiting mid-wicket fielder.
10.2: Beloved Biza offers room outside the off stump, allowing Deepti Sharma to sweep it away toward deep extra cover for a single.
10.3: Beloved Biza unleashes a slower, shorter ball outside off, and Niki Prasad slices it over the keeper for a four.
10.4: Biza delivered a length ball around off, Niki Prasad struck it back to the bowler, no run.
10.5: Beloved Biza tosses it up outside off, and Niki Prasad drives it firmly along the grass to long-off for a single while Mandhana watches with a smile from the dugout.
10.6: Beloved Biza drifts a seventy-five point two kilometers per hour delivery right up to the bat, allowing Deepti Sharma to glide it straight to long-on to retain the strike.
11.1: Michelle Mavunga delivers a full‑length ball, Deepti Sharma slices it through the leg side to the boundary.
11.2: Michelle Mavunga lines a leg‑side shot to Deepti Sharma, who flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
11.3: Michelle Mavunga sends a single to Niki Prasad.
11.4: Michelle Mavunga drops it full, and Deepti Sharma promptly collapses onto one knee, dispatching the slog sweep into the empty spaces of deep mid-wicket for four.
11.5: Michelle Mavunga angles one razor-close to the tramline outside off, prompting Deepti Sharma to offer no stroke while the umpire shakes his head at the wide appeal.
11.6: Michelle Mavunga gifts width on a length, and Deepti Sharma uses her blade to carve a fierce cut past point, advancing to forty-seven in style.
12.1: Beloved Biza tosses it up to Niki Prasad, who sinks to one knee and sweeps cleanly toward deep square leg to collect a single.
12.2: Beloved Biza tosses up a looping delivery that Deepti Sharma brings her bat down on and whips away to deep square leg, though Niki's call for a second is immediately and firmly refused.
12.3: A single to Niki Prasad off Beloved Biza.
12.4: Beloved Biza offers a full delivery outside off, and Deepti Sharma presents the full face of the bat to punch it down to long-on, advancing her score to 49.
12.5: Beloved Biza overcooks the flight to serve up a full toss on the pads, allowing Niki Prasad to charge down the pitch and tuck it toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
12.6: Beloved Biza loops it up to Deepti Sharma, who dead-bats the straight delivery back to the bowler, leaving her stranded on forty-nine for the over.
13.1: Olinder Chare darts one in with the arm, and Niki Prasad comfortably dead-bats the ball right back to the bowler's hands.
13.2: Olinder Chare flights it up, and Niki Prasad calmly punches it down to long off for a single.
13.3: Olinder Chare comes round the wicket with a floated delivery down leg, met by Deepti Sharma's sweeping blade straight to short fine leg.
13.4: Olinder Chare claims the wicket as Deepti Sharma departs for 49 after her sweep catches a top-edge safely into the hands of Mayers.
13.5: Olinder Chare loops it up full on the stumps, and Richa Ghosh drills the ball hard past the lunging bowler to secure a single.
13.6: Olinder Chare offers width, allowing Niki Prasad to hang back in her crease and carve a clean cut past point to keep the strike.
14.1: Beloved Biza delivers, and Niki Prasad collects a single out to long on.
14.2: Beloved Biza targets the fifth-stump channel, extracting sharp extra bounce that whistles past Richa Ghosh's flashing blade as she attempts a late cut.
14.3: Beloved Biza offers enticing flight into the slot on off stump, and Richa Ghosh unleashes blistering hand-speed to pulverize a maximum straight past the bowler's head.
14.4: Beloved Biza pulls her length back sharply, leaving Richa Ghosh stranded in the crease to inside-edge a defensive prod onto her pads.

14.5: Beloved Biza loops it up to Richa Ghosh, who swings hard across the line, miscues the slog sweep off a thick top edge, and watches it balloon high toward deep mid-wicket where Nyasha Gwanzura settles comfortably underneath to snap up the catch.

14.6: Beloved Biza darts a quicker full delivery into the pads of Arundhati Reddy, who gets down swiftly to sweep it cleanly along the turf to deep square leg for a single, leaving just four runs required.
15.1: Tendai Makusha hurries Arundhati Reddy with a sharp, skiddy length that catches an inside edge, scuttling away toward fine leg for a scampered single.
15.2: Tendai Makusha beats Niki Prasad on the flick, and the umpire's outstretched arms stay firmly down as the ball brushes inside the leg-side guideline.
15.3: Dot ball from Tendai Makusha to Niki Prasad.
15.4: Tendai Makusha delivers to Niki Prasad, who punches a pristine straight drive flashing past the bowler's left hand and racing away to the boundary.

summary.text: India Women won by 4 wkts after chasing down the ZIMW innings total of 114-5. Sharne Mayers was the top scorer in the first innings with 43 off 33 balls, while Nandani Sharma took 2 for 11. In the chase, Deepti Sharma scored 49 off 37 balls to lead INDW to 116-6 despite Nyasha Gwanzura taking 3 for 18.
